headline: Altimeter aims to invest $5 billion in Anthropic IPO
body: Altimeter Capital is aiming to invest $5 billion in the Anthropic initial public offering, Brad Gerstner told CNBC. Gerstner noted that the investment would be five times the amount he has put into any IPO. CNBC reports Anthropic is expected to go on Nasdaq on Thursday, with the price currently expected at $70 to $78 a share.
note: Chipmakers and cloud providers, many of which count on Anthropic as a customer, are collectively investing $26 billion at the IPO price.
